results.title: Unraveled
results.overview: On the verge of his Bar Mitzvah, Simon’s recurring nightmares about dropping the Torah threaten to derail his big day.  Simon is only three days away from his Bar Mitzvah and the nightmares are getting worse. This Saturday, he becomes a man in the eyes of Judaism. His Father, recently divorced, is on a religious journey of his own. Heartbroken by his ex-wife’s remarriage, Simon’s father has become an orthodox Jew. He spends his days wrapped in Tefillin, and cloaked in his Tallis.  As Simon’s Father urges him towards blind faith rather than understanding, Simon finds himself haunted by his Torah portion and by his fear of dropping the Torah.  As his Bar Mitzvah grows closer, Simon’s nightmares grow more vivid. As the day arrives, Simon is called forth in front of the entire congregation to deliver his Torah Portion, and to share his beliefs with the community. His father watches on, desperate to see his son take the same path as him.

results.title: shortly
results.overview: Experimental film. Reflections on the Russian film industry.

results.title: A Kind of Madness
results.overview: A 70-year old man abducts his dementia-suffering wife from her retirement home and goes on the run from both the police and his adult children.

results.title: Amours, la révolution Z
results.overview: Has Generation Z killed love? Online dating, polyamory, casual flings, platonic relationships— in a world where love is experienced through screens, Generation Z is challenging the rules of romance. Clara Pelletier sets out to meet her peers, questioning their beliefs and practices, with the aim of shedding light on today’s and tomorrow’s relationships. What if Generation Z is trying to reinvent love in order to save it?

results.title: Writer
results.overview: Year 1956. Rodolfo Walsh, young writer and translator, is an involuntary testimony of a failed insurrection attempt against the military dictatorship in Argentina. A little while later he receives the news that there are some survivors of the massacre. Together with his young colleague, they begin an investigate adventure which will bring them to the center of the labyrinth of power. The adventure will unite them in front of innumerable dangers that they'll face. A story of love and a political thriller all to the background of the tragic story of Argentina

results.title: Townshend
results.overview: In Townshend, Arthur Jafa transforms a still photograph of Pete Townshend, originally taken by celebrated music photographer Michael Putland, into a disquieting moving portrait. Using an AI programme to reanimate the static image, Jafa produces a face that blinks, twitches, and turns almost imperceptibly.

results.title: Captain Hook
results.overview: Nikita Kryukov is a successful hockey player in the past, who ended his sports and then his agent career because of his uncontrollable anger. No one is ready to work with him. Suddenly, he receives a message about his mother's death. He breaks off to his hometown. But it turns out that this message was sent by the mother's youngest daughter from her second husband. After his father's death, Nikita almost immediately went to Moscow, and then to America, and all this time he did not communicate with his mother — he could not forgive the fact that she almost immediately got together with another.

results.title: Capharnaüm
results.overview: While desperately trying to finish his movie, a young filmmaker must face the imminent death of his father.

results.title: Retta Thala
results.overview: Kaali, a struggling Pondicherry orphan encounters his rich Goa doppelganger Malpe Upendra with criminal past, leading to identity swaps and messy consequences. Corrupt cop Thiraviyam and Upendra’s enemies soon conspire to put that to an end.

results.title: Strandzha
results.overview: The debut documentary by Bulgarian-born German resident and renowned photographer Pepa Hristova is set in the Strandzha mountains, the natural border between Bulgaria and Turkey. In that sparsely populated land and in one of the last primeval European forests is a crossroads between ancient rituals, nationalism, migration and anarchy, as the bleak past blends with modern-day threats in a terra incognita for the West.

results.title: Creeping Charlie
results.overview: A couple checks into a bed and breakfast and are soon put off as their host seems a little unhinged.

results.title: There Once Was a Tiger
results.overview: The story of an unusual friendship between a tiger and a goat in a seaside zoo. About how a spontaneous goat helped a bored tiger find freedom.

results.title: The Wait
results.overview: A future father struggles with the ghosts of his past as he tries to reconnect with his absent father, unleashing disturbing nightmares that force him to confront his insecurities about parenthood.

results.title: About Luis
results.overview: The two people in their late thirties, Constanze and Jens, have a very stressful daily life. Their situation intensifies when their ten-year-old son Luis begins having problems at school. The parents now find themselves in conflict between fulfilling societal conventions and trying to protect their son. The existing values of both are put to a severe test. They underestimate how much Luis is being bullied at school and that he urgently needs help.

results.title: Marching Powder
results.overview: Middle-aged Jack, arrested for drugs, strives in six weeks to repair his marriage, curb a bullying in-law, and guide his stepbrother in the right direction, but all efforts fail as his life spirals further out of control.

results.title: Obi Is A Boy
results.overview: A gender-non-conforming young man must confront his estranged family when he returns home for his mother's funeral.

results.title: Torn
results.overview: Hava is having a myoma removed in a routine procedure. What was intended as a straightforward surgery turns into a nightmare: due to suspected malignant tissue, a complete hysterectomy is performed—a precautionary measure that forever alters Hava’s life. When she realizes the extent of the procedure, she feels stripped of her femininity and doesn’t know how to explain the irreversible damage to her boyfriend.

results.title: Les Décaféinés : Les 2 derniers amis du monde
results.original_title: Les Décaféinés : Les 2 derniers amis du monde
results.overview: In a world where no one gets along anymore, Rémi Deval and Clément Parmentier are the last two true friends, which makes them outcasts. To become normal again, they will do everything they can to fall out. Written in collaboration with La Bajon and Vincent Leroy, their show explores the absurdities of the times. Recorded for the Comédie+ channel on December 11, 2024, at the Espace Culturel de Villeneuve-le-Roi, in Val-de-Marne.

results.title: The Clairvoyant
results.overview: Marcus is in deep trouble. He’s being hunted down by a ruthless gangster demanding repayment of a debt that ties him to his late brother, Tony. The problem? Whatever Tony knew about the missing money died with him — or so it seems.

results.title: Across the Aisle
results.overview: An idealistic congressman attempts to woo his colleague from the other side of the aisle.
